title: About sexually transmitted infections
body: Sexually transmitted infections (STIs) are infections that can be passed mainly through sexual contact. Some infections may cause no symptoms, so testing and professional assessment can be important when exposure is possible.
source: WHO STI fact sheets/guidance

title: Kuhusu magonjwa ya zinaa
body: Magonjwa ya zinaa (STI) ni maambukizi yanayoweza kuenea hasa kupitia ngono. Baadhi yanaweza kutokuwa na dalili, hivyo kupima na kupata ushauri wa mhudumu wa afya ni muhimu ikiwa kuna uwezekano wa kuambukizwa.
source: WHO STI fact sheets/guidance

title: What is gonorrhoea?
body: Gonorrhoea is a sexually transmitted infection caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae. It can affect genital, rectal and throat sites. A laboratory test and clinical assessment are used to determine whether a person has gonorrhoea.
source: WHO gonorrhoea/STI guidance

title: Kisonono ni nini?
body: Kisonono ni ugonjwa wa zinaa unaosababishwa na bakteria Neisseria gonorrhoeae. Unaweza kuathiri sehemu za siri, njia ya haja kubwa na koo. Kipimo cha maabara pamoja na tathmini ya mhudumu wa afya hutumika kubaini maambukizi.
source: WHO gonorrhoea/STI guidance

title: Symptoms and testing
body: Gonorrhoea may cause pain or burning during urination or genital discharge, but some people have no symptoms. Symptoms alone cannot confirm gonorrhoea; appropriate testing and professional assessment are needed.
source: WHO gonorrhoea/STI guidance

title: Dalili na kupima
body: Kisonono kinaweza kusababisha maumivu au kuungua wakati wa kukojoa au uchafu kutoka sehemu za siri, lakini baadhi ya watu hawana dalili. Dalili pekee haziwezi kuthibitisha kisonono; kipimo kinachofaa na tathmini ya mhudumu wa afya vinahitajika.
source: WHO gonorrhoea/STI guidance

title: Prevention
body: Risk can be reduced through correct and consistent condom use, STI testing when appropriate, and communication with sexual partners. Local clinical guidance should be followed for testing, treatment and partner management.
source: WHO STI prevention guidance

title: Kujikinga
body: Hatari inaweza kupunguzwa kwa kutumia kondomu kwa usahihi na kila mara, kupima STI inapofaa, na kuwasiliana na wenzi wa ngono. Mwongozo wa kitabibu wa eneo husika unapaswa kufuatwa kuhusu vipimo, matibabu na usimamizi wa wenzi.
source: WHO STI prevention guidance

title: Understanding STI symptoms
body: Symptoms can have several causes. A healthcare professional can assess symptoms and recommend appropriate STI tests.

title: Dalili za STI
body: Dalili zinaweza kuwa na sababu mbalimbali. Mhudumu wa afya anaweza kufanya tathmini na kupendekeza vipimo vinavyofaa.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: STI testing
body: Testing can help identify infections even when symptoms are absent. Ask a qualified health professional which tests and timing suit your exposure.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Vipimo vya STI
body: Vipimo vinaweza kugundua maambukizi hata bila dalili. Muulize mhudumu wa afya kuhusu vipimo na muda unaofaa.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: When to test
body: The appropriate testing time depends on the infection, exposure and test. Ask a health professional whether follow-up testing is needed.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Wakati wa kupima
body: Muda unaofaa wa kupima hutegemea maambukizi na aina ya kipimo. Uliza mhudumu wa afya ikiwa kipimo cha kurudia kinahitajika.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: STI treatment
body: Treatment depends on the diagnosed infection. Seek professional care rather than self-medicating.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Matibabu ya STI
body: Matibabu hutegemea maambukizi yaliyothibitishwa. Tafuta huduma ya afya badala ya kujitibu.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Medicines for STIs
body: Do not use leftover or someone else’s antibiotics. A qualified clinician should choose treatment after appropriate assessment.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Dawa za STI
body: Usitumie antibiotiki zilizobaki au za mtu mwingine. Mhudumu wa afya anapaswa kuchagua matibabu baada ya tathmini.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Preventing STIs
body: Condom use, appropriate vaccination, testing and informed partner communication can reduce STI risks.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Kuzuia STI
body: Kutumia kondomu, chanjo zinazofaa, kupima na mawasiliano na mwenza kunaweza kupunguza hatari za STI.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: How STIs spread
body: Different STIs spread through different kinds of sexual contact. Some infections can spread without visible symptoms.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Jinsi STI zinavyoenea
body: STI mbalimbali huenea kupitia aina tofauti za ngono. Baadhi huenea hata bila dalili zinazoonekana.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Possible STI exposure
body: Risk depends on the type of contact and infection. Seek timely professional advice about testing and prevention.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Uwezekano wa kuambukizwa STI
body: Hatari hutegemea aina ya mawasiliano na maambukizi. Tafuta ushauri wa mhudumu wa afya kuhusu kupima na kujikinga.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Seek prompt medical assessment
body: Severe pain, fainting or serious illness needs prompt medical assessment. Do not rely on a chatbot for emergency care.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Tafuta huduma ya afya haraka
body: Maumivu makali, kuzimia au ugonjwa mkali unahitaji tathmini ya haraka ya mhudumu wa afya.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Talking with partners
body: A healthcare professional can help you discuss testing and care with partners confidentially.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Kuzungumza na mwenza
body: Mhudumu wa afya anaweza kukusaidia kuzungumza na mwenza kuhusu vipimo na huduma kwa siri.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Checking STI myths
body: STI information should be checked against reliable public-health guidance; appearance alone cannot establish infection status.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Kuchunguza dhana potofu kuhusu STI
body: Taarifa za STI zinapaswa kuthibitishwa kupitia miongozo ya afya ya umma; mwonekano pekee hauwezi kuthibitisha maambukizi.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: STI information
body: STIs are infections commonly transmitted through sexual contact. Testing and professional care can be important.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Taarifa za STI
body: STI ni maambukizi yanayoenezwa mara nyingi kupitia ngono. Vipimo na huduma za afya ni muhimu.
source: Draft educational summary; requires qualified clinical and language review

title: Genital itching
body: Genital itching can have different causes, including irritation, skin conditions and infections. Avoid assuming it is an STI. A clinician can examine persistent itching and advise whether testing is appropriate.
source: Educational draft — requires clinical and language review

title: Kuwashwa sehemu za siri
body: Kuwashwa sehemu za siri kunaweza kusababishwa na muwasho, matatizo ya ngozi au maambukizi. Si lazima iwe STI. Tafuta tathmini ya mhudumu wa afya ikiwa kunaendelea.
source: Educational draft — requires clinical and language review

title: Pain or burning when urinating
body: Pain or burning when passing urine may occur with a urinary tract infection, irritation or some STIs. The symptom alone cannot identify the cause. Seek professional assessment, particularly if symptoms persist or you have fever or severe pain.
source: Educational draft — requires clinical and language review

title: Maumivu wakati wa kukojoa
body: Maumivu wakati wa kukojoa yanaweza kutokana na maambukizi ya njia ya mkojo, muwasho au baadhi ya STI. Dalili pekee haiwezi kubainisha chanzo. Tafuta tathmini ya mhudumu wa afya.
source: Educational draft — requires clinical and language review

title: Yellow urine
body: Yellow urine is often normal, and darker yellow urine can occur when you are dehydrated. Colour alone does not indicate an STI. Seek medical assessment if the change persists or occurs with pain, fever, blood in urine or other concerning symptoms.
source: Educational draft — requires clinical and language review

title: Mkojo wa njano
body: Mkojo wa njano mara nyingi ni wa kawaida; njano iliyokolea inaweza kutokea mwili unapokosa maji. Rangi pekee haithibitishi STI. Tafuta ushauri wa afya ikiwa kuna maumivu, homa au damu kwenye mkojo.
source: Educational draft — requires clinical and language review

title: Unusual genital discharge
body: Changes in genital discharge can have different causes, including infections. A qualified health professional can assess the discharge and recommend appropriate tests.
source: Educational draft — requires clinical and language review

title: Uchafu usio wa kawaida sehemu za siri
body: Mabadiliko ya uchafu sehemu za siri yanaweza kuwa na sababu mbalimbali, ikiwemo maambukizi. Mhudumu wa afya anaweza kufanya tathmini na kupendekeza vipimo.
source: Educational draft — requires clinical and language review

title: Genital sores or blisters
body: Sores or blisters around the genitals have several possible causes. Avoid self-diagnosis; seek clinical assessment and advice on testing.
source: Educational draft — requires clinical and language review

title: Vidonda sehemu za siri
body: Vidonda sehemu za siri vinaweza kuwa na sababu mbalimbali. Epuka kujitambua ugonjwa; tafuta tathmini ya mhudumu wa afya.
source: Educational draft — requires clinical and language review
